content.title: Rahmania Commercial Centres
summary: Full fit-out of two commercial centres within the 2,500-home Douira residential development, completed and handed over in 2025.

Received as raw reinforced concrete frames, both structures were transformed into fully operational retail environments — with glazed curtain walls, architectural screens, and naturally lit retail floors.
description: SARL Igloo Yapi Construction executed the complete secondary works package for both commercial buildings. Raw concrete frames were fitted out with glazed curtain walling integrated with decorative architectural screens, bringing the exterior envelopes to finished standard.

Internally, vertical circulation is anchored by a central staircase clad in granite, while a structural pyramid glass skylight floods the retail floor plates with natural daylight. Both centres were completed on schedule to meet modern commercial building standards.
content.authority: Completed in 2025, the project was delivered on schedule, with all secondary trades coordinated to meet modern commercial building standards.

faq.question: What is the scope of the Rahmania Commercial Centres project?
faq.answer: Full fit-out of two commercial centres within Douira's 2,500-home residential programme — from raw concrete frame to fully operational retail environments. Completed in 2025.

faq.question: What technical works were executed?
faq.answer: SARL Igloo Yapi Construction managed the complete fit-out, including interior partitions and finishes, glazed curtain walling, architectural screens, granite-clad staircases, and installation of the structural pyramid glass skylight.

faq.question: When was the commercial development completed?
faq.answer: Both commercial centres were completed and handed over in 2025, delivered on schedule as part of the wider 2,500-home Douira residential programme.
